rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for repairing a damaged or ruined thing and getting it back into good condition.

example.english: My computer broke, so I took it in to restore it.
example.traditional: 部電腦壞咗，我攞去整返好。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2 ngo5 lo2 heoi3 zing2 faan1 hou2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for bringing back a condition, situation, relationship, or state of affairs.

example.english: After the storm, we could finally restore power.
example.traditional: 暴雨過後，我哋終於可以恢復供電。
example.jyutping: bou6 jyu5 gwo3 hau6 ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 fui1 fuk6 gung1 din6

rows.note: Use this when giving something back to its owner or returning something that was lost or taken.

example.english: I’ll restore your book to you tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 waan4 faan1 bun2 syu1 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this mainly for restoring data, files, or a system from a backup or to an earlier state.

example.english: I used the backup to restore the photos.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 bei6 fan6 zoeng1 di1 soeng2 waan4 jyun4
